_comment: Narration on the path: a stranger on the road, talking to the visitor (the bounty hunter) about the wanted developer. The app reads this for subtitles; scripts/voice/generate.mjs synthesises public/audio/voice/line<i>.mp3 from it. Placeholder voice until a real recording exists.
lines: Evening. You're out late — looking for someone, I'd wager.
Word is there's a developer in these parts who takes every job all the way to production.
Front end, back end, the database in between — he doesn't leave a task half-done.
The tavern's just ahead. His notice is on the wall. Wanted alive, mind — he's more useful that way.
